translation: The Lingshu Jing says: The chest qi has a street, the abdominal qi has a street, the head qi has a street, and the shin qi has a street. Therefore qi in the head stops at the brain; qi in the chest stops at the chest and the back shu points; qi in the abdomen stops at the back shu points and at the arteries of the Chong vessel on the left and right of the navel; qi in the shin stops at Qijie and at Chengshan (BL57) and below the ankle.
